name: AICTE - Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship
benefit:
**The Fellowship consists of -**
(i) An honorarium of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand per day) for full-day interaction with the Faculty/ Students of the host institute and nearby located institutions up to a maximum of five days in a single trip.
(ii) Actual expenses on travel by train / air/ car etc.

_eligibility_text: 1. The awardee must be a highly qualified superannuated Professional in his/her field. 1. The awardee should be an acknowledged leader (expert) in that particular field of specialization having actively engaged in research and development. 1. The awardee should have contributed to the development of society through his / her excellent fieldwork.
